---
title: "Project Structure"
---

Describe how a typical project folder should be laid out.

```
my-project/
├── data/
│   ├── raw/
│   └── processed/
├── code/
├── output/
└── README.md
```

## Folders

| Folder    | What goes in it                     |
|-----------|-------------------------------------|
| `data/`   | Raw and processed data              |
| `code/`   | Scripts, numbered in the order run  |
| `output/` | Figures and tables                  |
